titulo.alumno: Absence and a message · In class and on a course

intro: Part 3: absence and a message. Compare the two clues and distinguish what the text says from what it only seems to suggest.

frases.estudio: Lea var syg i går og blev hjemme.
frases.alumno: Lea was ill yesterday and stayed at home.
She will send the task tomorrow.

texto: In instructions, «skal» marks what must be done; «kan» points to a possibility. Subordinate clauses with «fordi» keep the subject before the conjugated verb.
Compare the two clues and distinguish what the text says from what it only seems to suggest.
